title: Chateau Meichtry Family Vineyard and Winery
blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings or a glass of wine while enjoying the scenic foothills of the Appalachian Mountains. Tours are offered every Saturday at 12:30 p.m. with private tours available for groups of 6 or more. Live music and food trucks are available on weekends from 1:30 to 5:30 p.m.
